nodes.description: Running count of minted/claimed tokens in xApe721; mutated in mint, claim and claimAll.
Cursor for the next candidate token ID used by _getNextUnusedID; starts at 10038.
IERC721 handle to the legacy 0xApes contract used for ownership checks and claims.
Private address that is the sole allowed caller of the onlyTeamWallet modifier and recipient of withdraw.
Boolean gate controlling whether public minting is enabled; toggled by pauseMint/startMint.
Prefix string concatenated with token id inside tokenURI; mutable via setBaseURI.
Privileged owner address checked against msg.sender for administrative functions.
Mapping of token id to owner, read/written by transfer, mint, burn and claim paths.
Mapping of holder to token balance, modified with unchecked increments/decrements.
Per-token approved spender mapping cleared on transfer.
Operator approval mapping consulted for transfer authorisation.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by approve/permit and decremented in transferFrom.
Per-owner nonce used inside permit signature digest and incremented unchecked.
Payable public mint that validates activation, supply, payment and per-tx limit then mints amount tokens in an unchecked loop.
Claims a single legacy token by pulling it from oldContract via safeTransferFrom and minting an equivalent new token.
Iterates all legacy tokens owned by msg.sender, pulls each from oldContract and mints them one by one.
Internal view helper that try/catch queries oldContract.ownerOf to verify legacy ownership.
Internal helper that scans up to 10 candidate IDs avoiding both new and legacy ownership before returning a free id.
View function returning baseURI concatenated with the decimal string of the token id.
Team-only function that forwards the whole contract balance to teamWallet via SafeTransferLib.safeTransferETH.
Owner-only function setting mintActive to false.
Owner-only function setting mintActive to true.
Owner-only function replacing the baseURI metadata prefix.
Modifier restricting execution to the hard-coded teamWallet address.
Core ERC721 transfer performing ownership, recipient and authorisation checks followed by unchecked balance updates.
Wraps transferFrom and then calls the recipient's onERC721Received hook when it is a contract.
Internal mint that guards against zero address and double mint, increments balance unchecked and sets ownerOf.
Internal burn that clears ownerOf/getApproved and decrements balance unchecked.
Owner-only ownership handover guarded by an explicit msg.sender comparison and a custom error.
Owner-only function setting _owner to the zero address.
EIP-2612 permit that checks deadline against block.timestamp, recovers the signer with ecrecover and writes allowance.
Library helper performing a raw assembly call to move ETH and reverting on failure.
Sets the caller's allowance for a spender.
ERC20 transferFrom decrementing allowance and balances with an unchecked recipient increment.
External call into the untrusted legacy contract during claim before totalSupply is finalised.
Repeated external call into the untrusted legacy contract inside the claimAll loop.
Arbitrary receiver callback invoked by safeTransferFrom after state changes, enabling reentrancy.
ecrecover usage in permit with malleable signature inputs v/r/s.
Low-level assembly call(gas(), to, amount, ...) performing an ETH transfer with all gas forwarded.
Unchecked block incrementing local supply inside the mint loop together with manual totalSupply accounting.
Untrusted external caller address used for authorisation, recipient and ownership checks across the contracts.
Block timestamp used as the permit deadline boundary inside ERC20.permit.
uint16 mint quantity supplied by the caller.
Legacy token id the caller attempts to claim.
Account whose legacy ownership is being verified.
Token id looked up on the legacy contract.
Token id used to build the metadata URI.
New metadata prefix supplied by the owner.
ERC20 spender being approved.
ERC20 allowance amount to set.
Source address of the ERC721 transfer.
Destination address of the ERC721 transfer.
Token id being transferred.
Recipient of a newly minted token.
Token id to mint.
Signer address recovered and compared inside permit.
Spender granted allowance by permit.
Allowance value signed in the permit digest.
Expiry timestamp compared against block.timestamp.
ETH recipient in the safe transfer helper.
ETH amount forwarded by the assembly call.
New owner address assigned by transferOwnership.
Airdrop recipient array passed to the constructor.
Airdrop token id array passed to the constructor.
Cached totalSupply copy incremented inside the unchecked mint loop.
uint16 loop counter over the requested mint amount.
Token id returned by _getNextUnusedID for each minted token.
Locally accumulated supply written back to totalSupply after the claim loop.
Array of legacy token ids returned by getPhunksBelongingToOwner.
Cached length of the owned tokens array used for gas.
Candidate token id advanced while occupied ids are skipped.
Boolean capturing the assembly call result before the require.
Address recovered from the signature and checked against owner.
Cached ownerOf[id] used for authorisation and emit.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient and controls the mint amount flow.
msg.sender drives the legacy ownership check and mint recipient in claim.
msg.sender is queried against the legacy contract and used as claimAll recipient.
onlyTeamWallet authorises callers by comparing msg.sender against teamWallet.
pauseMint gates execution on msg.sender being the owner.
startMint gates execution on msg.sender being the owner.
setBaseURI gates execution on msg.sender being the owner.
transferOwnership reverts unless msg.sender equals _owner.
renounceOwnership reverts unless msg.sender equals _owner.
transferFrom authorises the caller against from, getApproved and isApprovedForAll.
permit compares the user supplied deadline against block.timestamp.
claim performs an untrusted external call before totalSupply accounting is finalised.
claimAll calls the untrusted legacy contract repeatedly inside an unguarded loop.
The external call targets the oldContract state variable.
The looped external call targets the oldContract state variable.
claim validates legacy ownership by calling _ownsOldToken.
claim mints a matching new token after the legacy transfer.
claim increments totalSupply after a successful legacy transfer.
claimAll mints every unclaimed legacy token of the caller.
claimAll writes the accumulated supply back to totalSupply.
mint resolves each new token id through _getNextUnusedID.
mint delegates the actual token creation to _mint.
mint accumulates totalSupply inside an unchecked block susceptible to manual accounting errors.
mint reads and finally writes the totalSupply state variable.
mint short-circuits on the mintActive flag.
_getNextUnusedID reads and advances nextMintableId.
_getNextUnusedID checks ownerOf to skip ids already minted here.
_getNextUnusedID try/catch queries oldContract.ownerOf for occupancy.
withdraw sends the balance to the teamWallet address.
withdraw delegates the ETH movement to SafeTransferLib.safeTransferETH.
safeTransferETH performs the low-level assembly call that forwards ETH.
The modifier compares the caller against the teamWallet state variable.
tokenURI concatenates the baseURI prefix with the token id.
tokenURI reverts when ownerOf[id] is the zero address.
_mint increments balanceOf[to] inside an unchecked block.
_mint writes the new owner into ownerOf.
transferFrom decrements and increments balances inside an unchecked block.
transferFrom reads the current owner and rewrites ownerOf[id].
transferFrom consults and deletes the getApproved entry.
transferFrom authorises operators through isApprovedForAll.
safeTransferFrom first performs the underlying transferFrom.
safeTransferFrom invokes arbitrary receiver code via onERC721Received after state changes.
_burn decrements balanceOf[owner] inside an unchecked block.
permit feeds the digest and v/r/s into ecrecover.
permit writes the recovered signer allowance.
permit increments the owner nonce inside an unchecked block.
approve overwrites the caller-spender allowance entry.
ERC20.transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
amount drives the price multiplication and loop bound in mint.
tokenId selects the legacy token to claim and the new id to mint.
The local supply counter is incremented unchecked per mint.
index bounds the unchecked mint loop.
newId is the freshly resolved id passed to _mint.
account is compared with the legacy owner returned by the try/catch call.
tokenId is queried through oldContract.ownerOf in the try/catch.
id is checked for existence and stringified into the URI.
_baseURI replaces the stored metadata prefix.
spender is the allowance key written by approve.
amount is the allowance value stored by approve.
from is checked for ownership and used in the balance decrement.
to must be non-zero and receives the balance increment.
id identifies the token being transferred.
to is the recipient validated against the zero address in _mint.
id is checked for prior minting and assigned in ownerOf.
owner must match the recovered signer and is used for the nonce and allowance writes.
spender receives the allowance granted by permit.
value is part of the digest and becomes the allowance.
deadline is compared with block.timestamp to bound signature validity.
to is the ETH recipient of the low-level call.
amount is the wei value forwarded by the assembly call.
_newOwner becomes the privileged owner after the msg.sender check.
recipients array entries are minted to during construction.
tokens array entries are minted as ids during construction.
The cached supply is incremented per successful claim inside the loop.
ownedTokens is the legacy id list iterated and minted by claimAll.
length bounds the claimAll iteration.
newId is advanced and finally returned as the free token id.
callStatus carries the assembly call result into the require.
recoveredAddress is validated non-zero and equal to owner.
owner caches ownerOf[id] for the emit and authorisation check.

normalization_plan.reason: The mint amount parameter only exists to drive the mint function's validation and loop, so fold it into mint.
The claimed tokenId parameter is only meaningful within claim and should collapse into that function node.
account is a transient argument of the ownership helper and merges into _ownsOldToken.
tokenId is a transient argument of the ownership helper and merges into _ownsOldToken.
The id parameter only parameterises the tokenURI view and should merge into it.
_baseURI is a single-purpose setter argument and merges into setBaseURI.
spender only feeds the approve mapping write and merges into approve.
amount only feeds the approve mapping write and merges into approve.
from is only used inside transferFrom checks and merges into that function.
to is only used inside transferFrom checks and merges into that function.
id only identifies the token inside transferFrom and merges into that function.
to is the mint recipient parameter and merges into _mint.
id is the mint token parameter and merges into _mint.
owner is a permit digest argument and merges into the permit function.
spender is a permit digest argument and merges into the permit function.
value is a permit digest argument and merges into the permit function.
deadline is consumed by the permit timestamp check and merges into permit.
to is the ETH recipient argument and merges into safeTransferETH.
amount is the ETH value argument and merges into safeTransferETH.
_newOwner only parameterises the ownership handover and merges into transferOwnership.
The airdrop recipients array is consumed directly by _mint calls in the constructor and merges into _mint.
The airdrop tokens array is consumed directly by _mint calls in the constructor and merges into _mint.
The local supply counter is part of the unchecked mint accounting and merges into mint.
The loop index is internal to mint and merges into mint.
The newId local is derived and consumed inside mint and merges into mint.
The cached supply in claimAll is written back to totalSupply and merges into claimAll.
ownedTokens exists only inside the claimAll loop and merges into claimAll.
The cached length is a gas optimisation local inside claimAll and merges into it.
The newId local drives the id scan in _getNextUnusedID and merges into it.
callStatus is the low-level call result local and merges into safeTransferETH.
recoveredAddress is the ecrecover result local and merges into permit.
The cached ownerOf value is local to transferFrom and merges into it.
